annie: FYI were scheduling a maintenance change window tonight 21:30 UTC to deploy a runtime flag tweak + rolling restarts of a subset of dedicated pools. Low risk but we need customer-facing comms (statuspage line, short email, ops FAQ + pin command). Who can draft?
deploy-bot: schedule=2026-09-02T21:30:00Z; canary=15m; rollout=60m; auto-rollback=on_error_rate>6%_for_5m; notify-channel=#eng-platform; runbook=/runbooks/runtime-tweak-2026-09-02.md
marco_ops: I can own runbook and pin list. Will collect customers that require auto-pin (p50<120ms) and send to support by 18:00 UTC.
lucy_support: I'll draft messaging. Posting three artifacts: (A) statuspage short, (B) email for impacted customers, (C) ops FAQ snippet.
lucy_support: STATUSPAGE (short): "Maintenance: rolling runtime update for dedicated inference pools in select regions. You may see brief request interruptions while pools restart. Window: 21:30 UTC  22:45 UTC. Updates: https://status.redwood.com/incident/20260902"
dan_product: please add a reassuring line in the email about quality checks: "We will pause the rollout if model output quality or error rates degrade beyond thresholds and notify affected customers."
lucy_support: added. EMAIL (impacted customers): "Subject: Planned maintenance: Redwood runtime update tonight 21:30 UTC

Hello,

We will perform a routine runtime configuration update and rolling restarts of a subset of dedicated inference pools starting at 21:30 UTC. Impact: you may observe short request interruptions or retries while affected pools restart.

If your account is on our critical SLA list we'll pin your workloads to the prior runtime snapshot for the duration. We will monitor metrics closely, pause the rollout if quality or error signals degrade beyond thresholds, and automatically rollback if safety limits are breached. Live updates will be posted to: https://status.redwood.com/incident/20260902

No action required unless this time conflicts with a production freeze. To request manual pinning or an alternate window reply to this message or contact support@redwood.com.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Operations"
marco_ops: OPS FAQ (snippet):
- What to expect: short request failures (502/503) and transient latency for affected pools.
- Will most requests succeed? Yes, traffic will route to warm pools when possible; some retries may occur.
- Pinning: we will auto-pin listed critical customers 15 minutes before the window. To request a manual pin use the internal pin endpoint.
- Rollback/pause: canary hold if quality/error thresholds hit; auto-rollback on sustained error >6% over 5m. Postmortem will be published if rollback occurs.
marco_ops: PIN COMMAND (internal):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/pins" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"customer_id":"cust-321","route":"/v1/complete","model":"rwd-13b-q","version":"2026-08-12"}'
```
kate_eng: small ops request: publish statuspage 30m prior (21:00 UTC), queue email at T+5 into canary (21:35 UTC), and send SMS to high-touch customers 10m before start. Also enable verbose canary tracing and capture token-level cost metrics for post-rollout export.
marco_ops: noted. I'll hand over the pinned-customer list to lucy by 18:00 UTC and schedule pins at 21:15 UTC.
lucy_support: queued statuspage publish 21:00 UTC and email at 21:35 UTC. I'll include localized time conversions (PDT/CEST/SGT) and support alias.
annie: post-rollout ask: export token-level cost delta and a short quality diff (5 sample prompts) for product. Tag #product-qa.
dan_product: acknowledged. we'll look at the quality diffs and notify if anything stands out.
lucy_support: final: templates saved to #ops-docs after this thread. flag edits here only. deploy-bot should post schedule changes here automatically. :white_check_mark:
